aboutGame.title: What is enfosi?
paragraphs: enfosi is a cooperative PvE defense game on Roblox from the Tumore group. You and your team defend a statue while waves of glaggles rush toward it, spotting disguised fakes in the crowd before they reach the objective.

Each wave introduces new enemies and bosses, and you unlock weapons, tools, and classes that change how you play. Higher difficulties such as maniac mode push loadout choices and team coordination to the limit.

items.question: What is enfosi?
items.answer: enfosi is a free-to-play co-op PvE defense game on Roblox by the Tumore group. You defend a statue from waves of glaggles, identify disguised fakes in the crowd, and use weapons, tools, and classes to survive increasingly hard waves and bosses.

items.question: Which class should beginners pick?
items.answer: Start with a straightforward, durable class while you learn enemy patterns and wave flow, then branch into support or high-damage classes once you know the maps.

items.question: Is enfosi playable on every device?
items.answer: The game is best experienced on PC. Other devices work, but the developers note enfosi is designed with PC controls in mind.

items.question: Where do I find active codes?
items.answer: Use the Codes page for working codes, rewards, expiration notes, and redeem instructions.

items.question: Are boss guides updated?
items.answer: Boss pages are organized with spawn notes, attack patterns, strategies, drop tables, and related next steps for progression.
